decisions.decision: Use distinct-source evidence keys rather than raw observation counts
decisions.rationale: 3-of-5 and independent destruction evidence must not be satisfied by duplicate or same-source observations.

decisions.decision: Implement heartbeat probe as a real state transition
decisions.rationale: Three heartbeat misses enter PROBE_REQUIRED; healthy telemetry is FALSE_ALARM; probe timeout or independent failure source confirms.

decisions.decision: Increment graph_version only for confirmed decision-relevant mutation
decisions.rationale: An observation arriving without confirmation must not trigger a policy decision or invalidate an action.

decisions.decision: Reject ACK identity mismatches and lease conflicts at execution time
decisions.rationale: Concurrency invariants must be enforced in the command lifecycle, not checked only after conflicting state exists.

decisions.decision: Gate records current git commit and complete source/config hashes without implicit re-baselining
decisions.rationale: Training must be refused if current HEAD or any attested source/config hash differs.

decisions.decision: Keep training_allowed=false until locked Python 3.11 legacy/C++ compatibility is actually rerun
decisions.rationale: The current environment has not established sb3_contrib and C++ bridge compatibility; no assumptions are promoted to PASS.
